test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"Why was the match postponed by the organizers?"

options.text: Why have the organizers postponed the match?
Why do the organizers postpone the match?
Why did the organizers postpone the match?
Why are the organizers postponing the match?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Why was the match postponed by the organizers?"
 
• To convert it into active voice: Identify the subject (the organizers) and the verb (postponed).
 
• Rearrange the sentence in active voice: "Why did the organizers postpone the match?"
 
• Ensure the tense remains consistent between the passive and active forms.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why did the organizers postpone the match?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Why have the organizers postponed the match?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 2:** "Why do the organizers postpone the match?" – Incorrect tense (present simple instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 4:** "Why are the organizers postponing the match?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous instead of past simple).
